lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots. The spots are most prominent in the mid-flank region, transitioning from larger, well-defined circles to smaller, more diffuse points toward the posterior peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to create a grid pattern. These intersections are most distinct in the region below and posterior to the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is clearly visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on its dorsal aspect to a deep shadow on its ventral aspect, extending from the mid-body toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs. These are concentrated primarily along the posterior half and the upper portion of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch is visible on the leading edge of the first dorsal fin near its apex. A horizontal linear marking is also present on the mid-lateral flank below the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The second dorsal fin and the upper lobe of the caudal fin are visible, both displaying high-luminance spot patterning.
